transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

I guess I came in because... well, it's about airplanes. Just the thought of getting on one right now... it scares me really bad. I know it doesn't make sense, but... my body just tells me that plane is going to fall. So... that's why I'm here.
Is it just airplanes that scare you, or are there other situations that make you feel similarly anxious?
No... just the planes. I don't really have that problem with anything else.
Have you ever had a panic attack, where you felt an intense fear or discomfort that reached a peak within minutes?
No... I don't think so. I mean, I just get... really scared about getting on a plane. But I don't know about all that. That's pretty much it.
Do you avoid flying due to this fear?

Yeah... I avoid it. I've... canceled shifts at the clinic. Skipped some medical meetings I was supposed to go to. I haven't even been back to Honduras to see my family in a while because... well, I just can't make myself go to the airport. If I do, I'm... shaking. I have to hold onto someone the whole time. So... I just don't go.
How long have you been afraid of flying?
About... seven months, I guess. I had to take a small plane right after I lost my job at the clinic, and... it was really turbulent. So... yeah. Since then.
Do you experience any physical symptoms, such as a racing heart or sweating, when you think about getting on a plane?

Yeah... I do. Um... even if I just get an email about a shift... a rural one, where I'd have to fly... it happens. My heart just starts pounding. Right away. And my hands get sweaty. I feel like... like I can't breathe. Not until I just... close the message.
Is your fear of flying specifically about the plane crashing, or is it about something else related to flying?

Yeah... it's about it crashing. I know it sounds... I know it doesn't make sense. I'm a doctor, I know the statistics. But... my body just tells me the plane is going to fall out of the sky. That's... that's why I came in. It just scares me too much.
Has your fear of flying affected your relationships with family or friends?

Yeah... I suppose. I've... delayed seeing my family. I just keep putting the trip off. 

And... well, it affects work, too. I've missed some important professional meetings. Since I keep turning down that flight-based coverage, it's... it's cost me income. And I think my colleagues are starting to question if they can even rely on me anymore. So... yeah. It's impacting things.
Are there other areas of your daily life, besides work and seeing your family, that are being affected by your fear of flying?
No... not really. Just those things.
Has your fear of flying affected your social life or friendships in any way?
No... not really. Like I said, it's mostly just work and... and my family. My friends are all local, so... it doesn't really come up with them.
Have you experienced anxiety in any other specific situations besides flying?
No. It's... it's just the flying. Nothing else.
Do you think your fear of flying is significantly interfering with your overall quality of life?

Yeah... I suppose it is. I mean... turning down flight-based coverage has cost me income. And... I know my colleagues are starting to question if they can rely on me. I've had to miss important professional meetings, too. And... like I said earlier, I've delayed seeing my family because of it. So... yeah. It does.
